landing.heroTitle: Learn a language with a cat who talks back.
landing.heroBody: Bite-sized lessons, a real conversation partner, and a little black cat who grows with you.
landing.talk.title: A cat who chats with you in the language you are learning
landing.talk.body: Speak or type to Smarty. He answers at your level, gently fixes your mistakes, and always asks you something back.
landing.talk.p2: Friendly corrections in your own language
landing.talk.p3: He reads every reply out loud
landing.talk.smarty1: Hi! What did you eat today?
landing.talk.smarty2: Yum, you ate pizza! Was it hot?
landing.bites.title: Lessons that fit in three minutes
landing.bites.body: Every lesson is split into short bites: meet new words, read a story aloud, practise, then listen and speak.
landing.bites.p1: Five levels, from first words to fluent
landing.bites.p2: Jump ahead with a short test
landing.bites.p3: Smarty notices what you get wrong and brings it back
landing.feed.title: Every lesson earns coins for Smarty
landing.feed.body: Finish lessons to earn coins. Spend them on food for Smarty and new things for his house, and watch him grow up a level.
landing.feed.cardSub: Feed him every day to keep him happy.
landing.room.title: Decorate Smarty's room
landing.room.body: Spend the coins you earn on beds, desks, chairs, shelves, windows and rugs. Tap anything in the room to swap it.
landing.read.title: Smarty follows along as you read
landing.read.body: Read stories aloud and see each word light up as you say it right. Great for pronunciation and confidence.
landing.compete.title: Leagues, streaks and daily quests
landing.compete.body: Climb from Bronze to Diamond every week, keep your streak burning and finish three fresh quests a day.
landing.schools.title: Made for classrooms too
landing.schools.body: Teachers and organizations can add learners, set work and follow progress.

landing.max.body: Smarty Max unlocks conversations with Smarty, personalised Practice and unlimited hearts.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.terms.title: Terms of service
legal.pending: Operator details are being confirmed before public release.
legal.contact: For privacy, parent consent, or account questions, contact:
legal.privacy.data.title: What we use
legal.privacy.data.body: We use your account email, display name, saved words, lesson results, progress, preferences and class membership to provide language learning. Passwords are stored as hashes. Session cookies keep you signed in. Your birth date is checked to choose the consent flow and is not saved.
legal.privacy.providers.title: Speech, AI and payments
legal.privacy.providers.body: Microphone access starts only when you choose a speaking activity. Your browser or device may send speech to its speech recognition provider. Text you send to AI is processed through OpenRouter and its model provider. Speech text is sent to Microsoft Azure; text moderation uses the configured safety provider. Dodo Payments processes purchases. Do not share personal or sensitive information in practice conversations.
legal.privacy.children.title: Children and parents
legal.privacy.children.body: Learners under 16 need verified parent or guardian consent before an account is created or learning data is collected. A parent must review this notice and complete verification with our support team. Parents can ask to review or delete their child’s information or withdraw consent. Withdrawing consent disables access until a new legal basis is established.
legal.privacy.retention.title: Storage and retention
legal.privacy.retention.body: Learning records are kept while your account is active. Account deletion removes learning data and access from our active database. Minimal payment records may be retained where required by law. Encrypted backups follow the operator’s retention schedule; deletion must also be reapplied after a restore. Provider retention depends on their contracts and policies.
legal.privacy.rights.title: Your choices
legal.privacy.rights.body: You can export your account data and delete your account in Settings. You can also ask for access, correction, portability, restriction, or objection where applicable, and contact your local data protection authority. Essential session cookies are required to sign in. We do not add advertising cookies in this app.
legal.terms.use.title: Using SmartyLang
legal.terms.use.body: Use the service for lawful language learning. Keep your sign-in details private and respect other learners. Children need verified parent or guardian permission. Class administrators must have permission to add students and assign work. Do not upload unlawful content or another person’s private information.
legal.terms.payments.title: Plans and billing
legal.terms.payments.body: The checkout displays the price, taxes and billing period before you pay. Paid access is granted only after the payment provider confirms payment. Cancellation stops future renewal and preserves access through the paid period where supported. Refunds and consumer cancellation rights follow applicable law and the checkout terms. Contact support about disputed charges.
legal.terms.ai.title: Learning and AI
legal.terms.ai.body: AI replies and automated scores can be wrong. Use them for practice and check important information with a teacher or trusted adult. The service does not provide professional medical, legal or financial advice. Automated moderation may replace a reply with a safe learning prompt.
legal.terms.rights.title: Your rights and service changes
legal.terms.rights.body: You keep rights to your own content and allow us to process it to provide the service. Do not copy or misuse content you are not entitled to use. We may suspend harmful or abusive activity. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer rights. Material changes to these terms must be communicated before taking effect.
safety.age.title: How old are you?
safety.age.body: Enter your date of birth so we can show the right consent steps. We do not save your birth date.
safety.parent.title: Ask a parent or guardian
safety.parent.body: Before you create an account or use learning features, your parent or guardian needs to review the privacy policy and complete a consent check. Please ask them to help with this step.
safety.parent.contact: Parents: contact support to complete verification and receive a consent code.
